meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把又长又乱的代码拆解整理成清晰好改的模块
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一堆难维护的老代码,想先理清结构再继续开发
copy.tagline_en: Break tangled code into clean, well-organized modules
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you inherited messy code and want it structured before building further.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按固定六阶段流程做重构:先分析代码库、画依赖图、评估测试覆盖,再分步改代码,每步之后跑测试和类型检查确认没有破坏。测试覆盖过低时会先暂停并建议补测试。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取或现代化代码时触发。可用参数控制范围(--scope=file/module/project)和风险(--strategy=safe/aggressive)。

say.text: 把 AuthService 里的校验逻辑抽成单独模块
say.note: 先分析依赖与测试,再分步实施
允许更大改动,但仍需测试覆盖足够

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a fixed six-phase refactor: analyze the codebase, build a dependency map, assess test coverage, then change code step by step, running tests and type checks after each step. If coverage is too low it pauses and suggests adding tests first.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code. Scope and risk are adjustable via --scope=file/module/project and --strategy=safe/aggressive.

say_en.note: Changes only this file, default safe strategy

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic in AuthService into its own module
say_en.note: Maps dependencies and tests, then works step by step
Allows broader changes, still needs adequate test coverage
